author: mark
text:
CI: add llvm-tools-preview component for tarpaulin

cargo-tarpaulin --engine llvm needs llvm-profdata / llvm-cov from
the llvm-tools-preview rustup component. The runner had only
rustfmt + clippy, so tests passed but coverage collection failed
with `Test failed during run`. Adding the component restores green
CI without changing the Makefile or lowering the 100% gate.
